notes: Printed: 'Whenever one or more creatures you control attack, they gain indestructible until end of turn.' The Guardian and a Bear attack, a second Bear stays home; after combat seat 0 casts Planar Cleansing ('Destroy all nonland permanents'). 'They' are the two attackers (CR 603.2c), indestructible until end of turn, and DESTROY spares an indestructible permanent (CR 702.12b; main 8db1834f): the attackers stay, the Bear that stayed home and the opponent's Giant are destroyed. Seat 1 takes 5 + 2. Before 8db1834f DESTROY ignored the keyword (gate round 10's MINOR-5 made this pack possible); on the base (30fabc4a) the sentence did not compile either (a needs-atom record).
